falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below this level would invalidate the bottom_2024_aug pattern match, as that pattern held a higher low structure; this would signal continuation lower rather than accumulation base formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained elevated fear pricing contradicts the bottoming pattern's characteristic VIX compression and would indicate market stress inconsistent with a constructive bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts further below -50 basis points (current ~-15bps)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion would signal escalating recession probability that the bottom_2024_aug pattern did not price in, invalidating the macroeconomic underpinning of the current verdict

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
